S.meta.title: Orbit Dash — wasan kari na sararin samaniya da taɓawa ɗaya
S.meta.desc: Da'irori biyu, taɓawa ɗaya. Yi tsalle a kan bugu cikin matakan kiɗa da aka gina da kiɗanmu, ka jure a gudu marar ƙarshe ka tattara wutsiyoyi don ƙwallonka. Kyauta a Android — kuma ana iya yin wasa kai tsaye a cikin burauza.
S.nav.label: Sassan shafin
S.hero.sub: Wasan kari na neon a can cikin sararin samaniya. Taɓa don canza da'ira, zame tsakanin ƙayoyi a kan kiɗan, ka tada taurari, waƙa bayan waƙa.
S.live.hint: Wannan shi ne ainihin wasan. Taɓa allon don ka buga matakin da kanka.
S.levels.title: Kowane mataki waƙa ce
S.levels.lead: Matakan da aka yi da hannu a kan waƙoƙin da aka rubuta don wasan. Ƙayoyi suna faɗuwa a kan bugun ganga, haske yana canzawa da kowane sashe, kuma nasararka ta farko tana ba ka sabuwar wutsiya.
S.levels.note: Samfuran daƙiƙa 12. Cikakkun waƙoƙi suna cikin wasan.
S.how.title: Koyi a daƙiƙa ɗaya. Ji daɗinsa tsawon makonni.
S.how.1.d: Ƙwallonka tana gudu a kewayen zobe. Taɓawa ɗaya a ko'ina, sai ta yi tsalle zuwa ɗayan da'irar: wannan ne duk sarrafawar.
S.how.2.d: Ƙayoyi suna zuwa tare da kiɗa. Taɓa a kan lokaci don zamewa tsakaninsu, ka kama tartsatsai na gefe don ɗaga kombo zuwa x5.
S.how.3.d: Jure har ƙarshen waƙar don ka wuce matakin. Tattara duk lu'u-lu'u tare da kashi 90% na tsalle a kan bugu, tauraron zai ba ka kambinsa.
S.blip.title: Haɗu da Blip
S.blip.lead: Blip shi ne bugun zuciya na ƙarshe na Babban Tauraro. Shiru ya daskarar da sararin sama, don haka yana birgima a kan da'irori a kan kiɗa, kuma kowace waƙa da ya kaɗa har ƙarshe tana tada tauraro.
S.rule.1: Da'irori su ne layukan waƙa: waƙar tana sauti ne kawai muddin wani yana birgima a kansu.
S.rule.2: Ƙayoyi taurari ne da Shiru ya daskarar. Ka taɓa ɗaya sai kiɗa ya tsaya, amma kari koyaushe zai iya sake farawa.
S.rule.3: Tartsatsai rayayyun bayanan kiɗa ne, lu'u-lu'u kuma guntun waƙoƙi. Kama su daga kusa, waƙar za ta ƙara haskakawa.
S.rule.4: Kaɗa waƙar tauraro har ƙarshe zai farka. Kaɗa ta ba tare da kuskure ba zai ba ka kambi.
S.char.blip.d: Kari mai rai da waƙar Babban Tauraro a cikinsa. Mai son sani, jarumi kuma ɗan rikitacce: yana saurin kuka, amma ba ya taɓa yin kasala.
S.char.mom.d: Mahaifiyar Blip. Ta ba shi waƙarta ta ƙarshe kuma yanzu tana barci a cikin ƙanƙara can nesa. Waƙar rairayinta ita ce babban jigon wasan.
S.char.moon.d: Mai gadin waƙa a hankali mai barci. Yana ɓoyewa a cikin mafarkai, yana tsoron kiɗa zai ƙare idan ya farka.
S.char.vega.d: Tauraruwar neon ta Birnin Neon kuma sarauniyar gudu. Ba ta taɓa faɗuwa a tsere ba: abokiyar hamayyar Blip da ta zama ƙawarsa.
S.char.silence.d: Ba dodo ba ne, sai rashin kiɗa: hazo mai sanyi mai launin shunayya da ke daskarar da taurari su zama ƙayoyi.
S.blip.epsLead: Kowane kashi mataki ne na wasan tare da waƙarsa.
S.ep.1: Daga ina Blip ya fito, da tauraro na farko da ya tada.
S.ep.2: Wata yana tsoron farkawa. Blip ya koyi cewa hutu ma wani ɓangare ne na waƙa.
S.ep.3: Tsere ta cikin Birnin Neon, inda komawa don abokiyar hamayya ya fi muhimmanci fiye da layin ƙarshe.
S.ep.4: Blip ya wuce Rijiyar Shiru a guje, inda tsoro ke rage gudun lokaci kansa — kuma ya koyi yin sauri fiye da tsoro.
S.ep.lights: An haife shi daga bugun zuciya na ƙarshe na wani tauraro, ƙaramin Blip yana kallon sama cike da fitilu — da ɗan baƙin ciki, da ɗan farin ciki. Sannan dusar ƙanƙara ta fara sauka.
S.ep.onetap: Birni mai launin toka, shiru tsit. Taɓawa ɗaya a kan bugu — sai duk daren ya haskaka ya yi rawa tare da Blip.
S.ep.witch: Shiru ya daskarar da Halloween. Taɓawa ɗaya a kan bugu — sai kabewa ta kama wuta, jemagu su tashi sama, Blip kuma ya zana hanyoyin kewayawar dare.
S.ep.witchdw: Daren Halloween ɗin nan dai, da waƙa mai ƙarin duhu: darkwave, jemagu da mayya a kan tsintsiya — kuma kowace taɓawa har yanzu tana faɗawa daidai kan bugu.
S.ep.hype: Blip ya sa tabaraunsa na rana — kuma duk duniyar taurari ta girgiza da kiɗa.
S.shop.title: Mai da ƙwallon taka
S.shop.lead: Wutsiyoyi, kamanni da ingantawa. Kowace wutsiya a nan injin wutsiyar wasan da kansa ne ke zana ta kai tsaye: taɓa ɗaya don gwadawa.
S.feat.title: Me ke ciki
S.feat.endless.d: Babu waƙa, babu ƙarshe: zobba suna ƙara sauri koyaushe. Har yaushe za ka jure?
S.feat.revive.d: Ka faɗi can cikin mataki? Farfaɗo a daidai inda kake ka ci gaba, ko ka ninka lu'u-lu'un da ka samu yanzu. Kambi yana ƙirguwa ne kawai ba tare da farfaɗowa ba.
S.feat.practice.t: Yi horo, sannan ka buga da gaske
S.feat.practice.d: Yi horo daga wuraren bincike ba tare da matsi ba. Idan ka shirya, buga da gaske tun daga farko.
S.feat.combo.d: Kama tartsatsai kusa da ƙayoyi don ɗaga kombo zuwa x5, ka ɗauki ƙarin ƙarfi: garkuwa, maganaɗisu, lu'u-lu'u ninki biyu, motsi a hankali da bugun da ke farfasa ƙayoyi.
S.feat.daily.d: Sababbin ayyuka uku kowace rana da jerin kwanaki bakwai. Rana ta bakwai ce ta fi bayarwa.
S.feat.ranks.d: Kowane sabon bajinta yana zuwa allunan jagorori na Google Play Games. Doke abokanka, sannan duniya.
S.feat.music.d: Kowace waƙa, daga jigogin menu zuwa kowane mataki, an rubuta ta don Orbit Dash. Zaɓi jigon menu a kan injin faifai a cikin saituna.
S.feat.langs.d: Wasan da wannan shafin suna magana da harshenka. Wasan yana zaɓar harshen wayarka da kansa. Canza shi a kowane lokaci da duniya a cikin saituna.
S.shots.title: Leƙa ciki
S.shots.daily: Ayyukan yau da kullum da jeri
S.shots.level: A tsakiyar mataki, a kan bugu
S.play.title: Yi wasa yanzu
S.play.lead: Dukan wasan yana aiki a burauzarka, a waya ko kwamfuta, ba tare da shigar da komai ba. Ci gabanka yana nan a wannan burauza; manhajar Android tana da nata.
